events.action:
{"message": "Fixed the off-by-one assertion failure in `alloc_chunk()` in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/lib/heap/heap.c`.

### Cause
`sys_heap_init()` allocates `bucket_idx(h, h->end_chunk) + 1` buckets (indices `0` through `bucket_idx(h, h->end_chunk)` inclusive), and `bytes_to_chunksz()` clamps the requested chunk size to `h->end_chunk`. However, `alloc_chunk()` checked `CHECK(bi < bucket_idx(h, h->end_chunk))`, which triggered an assertion failure whenever an allocation size fell into the top bucket (`bi == bucket_idx(h, h->end_chunk)`).

### Fix
Updated the assertion in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/lib/heap/heap.c:380` to `CHECK(bi <= bucket_idx(h, h->end_chunk))`.", "kind": "FinishAction"}

{"content": [{"cache_prompt": false, "type": "text", "text": "Fixed the off-by-one assertion failure in `alloc_chunk()` in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/lib/heap/heap.c`.

### Cause
`sys_heap_init()` allocates `bucket_idx(h, h->end_chunk) + 1` buckets (indices `0` through `bucket_idx(h, h->end_chunk)` inclusive), and `bytes_to_chunksz()` clamps the requested chunk size to `h->end_chunk`. However, `alloc_chunk()` checked `CHECK(bi < bucket_idx(h, h->end_chunk))`, which triggered an assertion failure whenever an allocation size fell into the top bucket (`bi == bucket_idx(h, h->end_chunk)`).

### Fix
Updated the assertion in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/lib/heap/heap.c:380` to `CHECK(bi <= bucket_idx(h, h->end_chunk))`."}], "is_error": false, "kind": "FinishObservation"}
